title: Threshold comparison conditions
attack: dense numeric thresholds and inequality operators

messages.content: Alert rules: trigger P0 when p95_latency_ms > 250 and error_rate >= 1.5%. Trigger P1 when queue_depth > 900 or cpu_utilization >= 88%. Do not alert when sample_size < 1000. Region ap-northeast-1, service gateway-v3.
